name: How often should I clean my bathroom sink drain?

mainEntity.name: How often should I clean my bathroom sink drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of cleaning depends on usage. For heavily used sinks, a monthly preventative flush with hot water and baking soda followed by vinegar can help maintain flow. If you notice slow draining, a more thorough cleaning is warranted. Waiting until the drain is fully blocked can lead to more complex and costly service calls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean your bathroom sink drain preventatively every 1-3 months, or immediately when slow draining occurs.
